summary.intent: Monitor PR #349 for new automated reviewer comments (CodeRabbit, Copilot) and automatically resolve them using /resolve-pr-reviews when detected.
summary.outcome: Successfully set up a 5-minute polling cron job, resolved 4 Copilot review threads (3 doc fixes + 1 real bug in recovery.html), and then manually fixed an additional 'outside diff range' CodeRabbit comment about an overly broad try/catch in useAuth.ts.

repo: VaultBlobV2 type was removed — functions that previously returned VaultBlobV2 now return Uint8Array directly
v2 vault blobs are key-only (ECIES-wrapped rootFolderKey), not key + metadata as older docs stated
recovery.html had a critical bug where vault key IPNS name was used for root folder traversal — requires deriving two separate IPNS names
IPNS derivation uses separate HKDF info constants for vault key IPNS vs root folder IPNS
fetchFromIpfs uses Axios and throws with error.response.status === 404 for missing CIDs, meaning a broad catch around IPFS/IPNS calls could falsely treat network errors as 'new user'

code.finding: Encryption table incorrectly described v2 blob as 'ECIES (key) + AES-256-GCM (metadata)' — it is key-only
Referenced VaultBlobV2 type which no longer exists; functions return Uint8Array
IPNS table described v2 blob as 'ECIES key + metadata' — corrected to 'ECIES-wrapped rootFolderKey only'
directRootIpnsName was derived as vault key IPNS name but used as root folder IPNS name for folder traversal — real bug requiring separate derivation
Overly broad try/catch: getVault() 404 should mean 'new user' but the catch covered all IPFS/IPNS calls, so a missing CID anywhere could incorrectly trigger vault re-initialization

workflow: CronCreate with recurring:true can be used to poll GitHub GraphQL API for PR review thread state every 5 minutes
gh api graphql with --jq filtering is effective for counting unresolved review threads by bot authors
Outside-diff-range review comments don't appear in normal thread queries and require fetching the specific review by ID
Cron jobs auto-expire after 7 days; CronDelete needed to cancel sooner
pnpm typecheck was sufficient to validate the useAuth.ts structural change before committing

friction: GitHub API timed out on one polling tick (transient network issue), causing a false 'unable to confirm' response
Outside-diff-range Copilot comments were not caught by the automated polling query and required manual user intervention to surface
recovery.html IPNS fix required multiple iterative reads to locate the right function and call sites due to file size
useAuth.ts indentation became inconsistent after the structural refactor and required a follow-up edit to fix
open_items: Cron monitor (job ID cadb6bcb) still running — will auto-expire in 7 days unless cancelled with CronDelete
useAuth.ts commit was staged but transcript ends before push/reply — unclear if that fix was fully pushed and the review thread replied to and resolved
The 'outside diff range' Copilot review (review ID 3996563546) may still have open threads if the reply/resolve step wasn't completed
